Dr. Yaga Lost House

 

Step into the shoes of a fearless video content creator in Dr. Yaga Lost House, a first-person psychological horror game that will keep you on edge. Known for exploring haunted houses and sharing his experiences with the world, our protagonist decides to take on his most terrifying challenge yet: the abandoned house of Dr. Yaga.

 

Dr. Yaga was a respected doctor in his town, but behind closed doors, he conducted unethical experiments on his patients, treating them as mere subjects for his twisted research. Now, the house is haunted by the consequences of his dark deeds, and it's up to you to uncover the truth and escape with your life. 

Key Features: Haunting Atmosphere: Experience a truly immersive horror environment with detailed graphics and creepy sound effects that heighten every moment.

• Engaging Storyline: Unravel the chilling story of Dr. Yaga as you search for clues, solve puzzles, and piece together the horrifying events that took place.

• Interactive Exploration: Navigate through a haunted house filled with hidden rooms, secret passages, and terrifying surprises.

• Challenging Puzzles: Use your intellect to solve intricate puzzles that unlock new areas and reveal more about the house’s dark past.

• Survival Mechanics: Manage your resources carefully as you avoid traps and protect yourself from the dangers that lurk in the shadows.

• Multiple Endings: Your choices will shape the outcome. Will you uncover all the secrets, or will you fall victim to the house’s horrors?

• Replayability: Discover alternative paths and unlock all the hidden content that the game offers. 

As you explore the haunted, abandoned house, will you be able to document the paranormal and survive the night? Dr. Yaga Lost House is a terrifying journey that will challenge your bravery.
description_short: Dr. Yaga Lost House is a first-person horror game where you play as a Video Content Creator exploring a haunted, abandoned house. Uncover dark secrets, solve puzzles, and survive the paranormal horrors left behind by Dr. Yaga. Can you escape the nightmare?
